A '''block of obol''' is a storage block made of 9 [[Obol]]s. It is the vanilla {{MCW|Block of Emerald|block of emerald}}, renamed along with the emerald.

== Usage ==
A block of obol can be crafted back into 9 obols, and works as a {{MCW|Beacon|beacon}} base block as in vanilla ''Minecraft''.
